test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the eligibility criteria for artisans under the PM Vishwakarma Yojana?

options.text: Must be engaged in traditional crafts
Must have a minimum income of ₹5 lakh
Must be employed in government services

solution:
The correct answer is __**Must be engaged in traditional crafts**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **PM Vishwakarma Yojana** is a central sector scheme launched to provide comprehensive support to **artisans and craftspeople** who work with their hands and tools.

• The primary eligibility criterion is that the applicant must be engaged in one of the **18 identified traditional trades**, which include occupations like **Carpenter, Boat Maker, Blacksmith, Potter, Sculptor, and Cobbler**, among others.

• The scheme is inclusive and covers artisans from both **rural and urban areas** across India; therefore, being restricted to urban areas is not a requirement.

• Individuals employed in **government services** and their family members are specifically **excluded** from the eligibility list.

• There is no requirement for a **minimum income of ₹5 lakh**; in fact, the scheme aims to uplift those at the grassroots level who often lack financial resources.

• The minimum age for registration under the scheme is **18 years**, and the benefit is restricted to **one member per family**.

• Applicants must not have taken loans under similar credit-based self-employment schemes like **PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra** in the last five years.

**Additional Information__**

• The scheme was officially launched on **September 17, 2023**, coinciding with **Vishwakarma Jayanti**.

• It has a total financial outlay of **₹13,000 crore** for a period of five years (FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28).

• Beneficiaries are provided with a **PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card**, which grants them formal recognition.

• The scheme offers **skill upgradation** through basic and advanced training, along with a **stipend of ₹500 per day** during the training period.

• A **toolkit incentive** of up to **₹15,000** is provided to help artisans purchase modern equipment.

• Artisans can access **collateral-free credit** of up to **₹3 lakh** (in two tranches of ₹1 lakh and ₹2 lakh) at a highly subsidized interest rate of **5%**.

• The **Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)** is the nodal ministry for the implementation of this scheme.
